fieldValues.comment_text: Evidence: (Q1) The two types are close but have different fields. muSrs boundary (muSrs/packages/argument/types/boundary-5091e5a0.json) has title, purpose, inside, outside, authority_basis and revision_condition, and no aiGuidance. Method domain (srs-programme/packages/method/types/domain-6e4d0e77.json) has title, purpose, in_scope and out_of_scope, and its aiGuidance says it "draws the boundary". srs-programme already holds 12 argument/boundary records alongside its 15 domains. muSrs has 7 boundaries, linked by 46 scopes-problem relations. (Q2) Option fields are statement, expected_benefit, protected_value and risk. Remedy fields are move, does_not_fix, falsifier and return_when. Counts: 13 options in muSrs, 56 remedies in the programme. (Q3) muSrs has no persona type. Its "persona" is a vocabulary (clerk, participant, founder, group, constituent: argument/vocabularies/persona-fce7c0a8.json) used as a field on problem. The programme has 10 persona and 36 persona-in-domain records. (Q4) essay/package.json has empty packageDependencies. Its relation types (bears-on, counters, comments-on) do not limit which record types they connect. srs-web/src/lib/essay names only com.mudemocracy.argument/source, plus "problem" and "claim" in prompt text, and neither package defines a claim type. Neither repo has any essay records. The agent documentation is muSrs/records/notes/maintaining-this-argument-repository-what-an-agent-needs-to-know-75814f46.json, which muDemocracy.org/AGENTS.md points to.
